scope: Selected per-session metrics and live observations, not complete scorecard copies. Null values are retained as archived; omitted metrics and evaluator markers cannot be recovered from this snapshot.

baseline.scorecard_contract: historical resolution-based evaluator with journal-marker-dependent path gates

rustfs-live-22.note: the answer that needed a camera evidence cost 7 to 8 seconds, the vision call 3.1 to 4.6 seconds

rustfs-live-38.note: a fresh vision inference costs 3 to 4.6 seconds, which is what holds the answer gate

metric_definitions.admission_to_listening_seconds: seconds from admission to the listening phase
metric_definitions.answer_audio_coverage: share of expected answers that produced audio
metric_definitions.attribution_coverage: attributed utterances divided by recorded utterances, rounded to three decimals; null when no utterances were recorded
metric_definitions.evidence_cache: historical resolution-based hits / (hits + misses): cache_hit counted as a hit, fresh as a miss; unavailable excluded
metric_definitions.first_answer_audio_p50_no_visual_seconds: median answer latency for the historical no_visual group; gated only when evidence_paths was true
metric_definitions.first_answer_audio_p50_seconds: median seconds from the end of speech to the first audio of the answer
metric_definitions.first_answer_audio_p50_visual_cached_sec: median answer latency for the historical visual_cached group, including the legacy screen-request fallback; gated only when evidence_paths was true
metric_definitions.first_audio_p50_seconds: median seconds from the end of speech to the first audio of the turn

historical_evaluator.path_classification: Used resolution, not acquisition/status. Without evidence_resolution_v2, the last recognized fresh/cache_hit event selected the path; absent such an event, a screen request fell back to visual_cached, all other turns to no_visual. With evidence_resolution_v2, fresh took precedence over cache_hit, then all-unavailable, then count-based missing telemetry detection; partial telemetry could be hidden by successful evidence.
historical_evaluator.scorecard_gating: session_targets.json was version 3. Path gates required evidence_paths=true; without that marker the evaluator omitted path gates and returned scorecard version 2. evidence_classification was unscored only when evidence_resolution_v2=true and evidence_unclassified was nonzero.
historical_evaluator.comparison_limits: The snapshot does not retain per-session journal markers or full scorecards, so it cannot establish the effective scorecard version or path algorithm used for every session. The canonical acquisition/status-based evaluator and evidence_provenance report were introduced after this baseline.

note: Archived metric snapshot frozen before Phase 4 reporting cleanup. Selected numbers are references, not complete scorecards or golden outputs for the canonical evaluator. Null does not mean zero or passed. Metric and classification semantics differ; numeric changes alone do not establish a performance improvement. Recomputing historical results requires the baseline commit and original session inputs.
